scope: Nonuniform root-mesh sensitivity only. Baseline root plateau .75mm/growth .4 changes to .5mm/.6, preserving minimum root/fillet .25mm and every CAD/material/load input. Not uniform h-refinement or proof of point-peak convergence.
mesh_screens: Every original SICN .05, positiveJ, actual CAD, each-material GP-J volume .1%, sharedTri6, connectivity, actual loads and GPU capacity gate must pass before GPU.
comparison: Actual energy/external work, material volumes and volume-weighted field statistics.
Common physical probes require actual quadratic isoparametric inversion and correct material IDs; no nearest-node/GP substitution.
Evaluate true P2 displacement and displacement-gradient stress. Check evaluator against saved original GP fields before using cross-mesh probes.
Gauge locations may differ: retain raw displacement differences and independently report a six-DOF rigid-motion-aligned displacement difference; stress/strain are gauge invariant.
Retain every unlocated probe with original ID/reason, never replace or zero-fill.
Report local point-stress sensitivity separately from volume norms; unchanged minimum root size limits convergence claims.
analysis_status: Protocol frozen before any variant GPU field; no numerical sensitivity results yet.
